messages.text: Manufacturing engineering needs one defensible decision for routing inspection step by 2026-01-18; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside routing sequence, predecessor, workcenter qualification, and open state.
I found 60 OPERATIONS on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0067 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000067 up to 42 OPERATIONS, provided routing sequence, predecessor, workcenter qualification, and open state. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or keep_superseded_routing.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for revised routing window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R9 and the CASE-068 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-067.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and send the scoped completion reply in the existing email thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
